## AC1 and AC2 are verified; AC3's evidence run was destroyed by my error, and has been re-dispatched

**AC1 / AC2 — verified.** Run
[35502010162](https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/35502010162)'s
`langfuse tracing round-trip (ephemeral self-hosted)` job completed `success` in 156s. The
`pull access denied for minio/minio` failure is gone.

**AC3 — the conditional is still unresolved, and that is my fault.**

AC3 asks whether the Jira DC harness still fails after the Langfuse fix. In that run, the
DC harness job was still `in_progress` at 6,748s while its 9 sibling jobs had all finished
in ~2 minutes. I read that as a hang and cancelled the run to release the logs.

**That was wrong, and the measurement shows it.** The last fully green run of that job
(job `98740362395`) took **6252.74s** for the same step, ending
`74 passed, 1 skipped, 1 xfailed ... in 6252.74s (1:44:12)`. The run I cancelled was at
**1.08x** that — entirely normal.

I reached the wrong conclusion because the workflow's own calibration comment claims the
step runs `2384-2635s over 63 tests`, against which 6,748s reads as 2.6x over. That comment
is stale by ~2.4x, and the job emits **no output at all** until its final second (the green
run's entire step log carries exactly `1` distinct timestamp), so there was no progress
signal to contradict it. Both of those are now tracked as bug `juiced-useful-shrike`
(`2277-7043-1f63-4f5c`), linked here as `discovered_from`.

**Remediation.** `external-integration.yml` re-dispatched against current `main`
(`e84e4c5e9439bcfd27875d152de36eb40eb4f46b`, which carries every fix landed this session) as
run [35508005436](https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/35508005436). The DC harness
lane needs ~1h45m–2h10m, so AC3 resolves when that job reaches a conclusion:

- **DC harness succeeds** -> AC3 is vacuously satisfied; nothing to track separately.
- **DC harness fails** -> AC3 requires a separate ticket carrying its job-log evidence,
  which will be filed from that run's log.

This ticket stays `in_progress` until that run concludes. Note that the 2026-09-14 run's
logs (job `103878992643`, the prior DC harness failure) are no longer retrievable —
`BlobNotFound` — so the re-dispatched run is the only available source of AC3 evidence.
